name: Progress M-16
about: Progress M-16 (1993-012A), a crewed vehicle (Progress M), launched 1993 Feb 21. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1993 Mar  1), held fixed
docked to S17845; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
